verdict.rationale: Bland provides explicit pre-production testing tools: the testbed for isolating and re-running node interactions with edited prompts (bland-docs-8, bland-docs-28, bland-docs-32), evals with LLM judges grading conversation quality (bland-docs-7, bland-docs-22, bland-docs-43), staged environments (development/staging/production) and version promotion before going live (bland-docs-2, bland-docs-42), and A/B/canary testing of new releases against live traffic before full rollout (bland-docs-21, bland-docs-29). Together these let developers simulate and grade conversations before real calls go out. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration of the eval and testbed workflows beyond vendor docs, and detail on how 'simulated conversations' (vs replaying real historical calls) are authored from scratch.
